AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF CHEYENNE
AND LARAMIE COUNTY
FOR ANIMAL CONTROL SERVICES
1.Parties.The parties to this Agreement are the City of Cheyenne, a municipality duly
organized and existing under the laws of the State of Wyoming, hereafter “City”who
address is 2101 O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, Wyoming 82001, and Laramie County, a
county government organized and existing under the laws of the State of Wyoming,
hereafter“County,”who address is 310West 19th Street, Cheyenne, Wyoming 82001.
2.Purpose of Agreement.The purpose of this Agreement is to authorize the City to furnish
the County with Animal Control services as setforth in this Agreement.
3.Term: This Agreement is effective upon approval and execution by the parties.The term
of this Agreement shall be from September 1,2021 through June 30,2022.The parties
may, by mutual agreement, renew this Agreement for additional one-year terms, through
an amendment reflecting then-current payment and any other relevant changes.
4.Payment: The County agrees to pay the following amount for Animal Control services
described herein.
a.The County shall pay upon reccipt of the City's invoice, for Animal Control
expenses only, the monthly amount of S10,900.00 for each of the months of
September 1,2021 through June 30,2022.
b.In no event shall the amount paid under this Agreement exceed $109,000.00.
c.The County shall furnish use of the Laramie County Combined Communications
Center (LCCCC) as a component of this agreement.Consideration for this
service is reflected in the agreed upon pricing detailed above.Such use shall be
limited to calls regarding animal control responsibilities detailed in Section5of
this Agreement received byLCCCCand calls received by L CCCC where Animal
Control is needed to support a law enforcement or other public safety agency.
The City shall provide Animal Controlwith their own radios; the Countywill not
provide anyradio equipment tothe City as part of this agreement.
5.City's Responsibilities.
a.The City shall operate Animal Control forboth the Cityof Cheyenne and the
unincorporated areas of Laramie County.All Animal Control operations in
unincorporated areas of Laramie County shall be conducted in conformance with
any applicable Wyoming state law asit may change from time to time and the
Laramie County Rabies Control District, Animal Control District and Animal
Control Regulations, Adopted July 20th,2004(Hereinafter the“Laramie County
regulations").
b.Such operations shall include, but not be limited to the following:

c.It shall be the City's responsibility to hire, train and manage all Animal Control
personnel and officerswho shall operate within the City of Cheyenne and the
unincorporated areas of Laramie County.
d. The City shall furnish to the County, through the Director of Compliance,
monthly reports reflecting such Animal Control statistics as are collected under
industry best practices. The report shall also include a description of any
complaints made regarding Animal Control services and the resolution of those
complaints and any public education programs conducted within that month.
e.The City shall perform operation of Animal Control in line with industry best
practices and shall maintain the professional and organizational integrity
expected of an organization engaged in providing animal control services.
6.County's Responsibilities.
a.The.County shall makepayment as specified in this Agreement.
b.The County shall promptly report any concerns or complaints received about
Animal Control services directly to the City, Attention: Directorof Compliance.
7.Responsibilities of Both Parties.
a.Establish and maintain records documenting calls and investigations conducted
by Animal Control officers including, but not limited to, records of complaints
received and the resolution of each complaint.
8.General Provisions.
a.Amendments. Any changes, modifications, revisions, or amendment to this
shall be incorporated by written instrument, executed, andsignedby all Parties to
this Agreement.
b.Applicable Law._The construction, interpretation, and enforcement of this
Agreement shali be governed by the laws of the State of Wyoming. The courts
of the State of Wyoming shall have jurisdiction over this Agreement and the
Parties, and the venue shall be in the First Judicial District, Laramie County,
Wyoming.
